title_zh: 民进中央原副主席、陕西省政协原副主席刘宽忍，被判15年
title_en: Liu Kuanren, Former Vice Chairman of Minshu Central and Shaanxi CPPCC, Sentenced to 15 Years
summary_zh: 民进中央原副主席、陕西省政协原副主席刘宽忍因职务犯罪被判处有期徒刑15年。
summary_en: Liu Kuanren, former vice chairman of the Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy and former vice chairman of Shaanxi Provincial CPPCC, was sentenced to 15 years in prison for duty-related crimes.
